ai_enabled.description: AI drafting on Post food. false: Review opens empty with "AI drafting is off right now." Values: true / false.

ai_model_name.description: First Gemini model the app tries (Firebase AI Logic). Must match gemini-[a-z0-9.-]. Shared with the functions' health check.

ai_fallback_model_names.description: Models tried in order when a model is retired or unknown. JSON array, max 4 names; the primary and duplicates are dropped.

ai_thinking_level.description: Analyzer thinking level: minimal, low, medium, high, or default (no thinking config). 3.7/3.8 Flash reject minimal.

ai_max_output_tokens.description: Analyzer max output tokens incl. thinking, 512-8192 (clamped).

ai_timeout_seconds.description: Analysis deadline for one photo, 10-60 s (clamped). Grows 4 s per extra photo.

ai_max_timeout_seconds.description: Cap on the analysis deadline with extra photos, at least ai_timeout_seconds, max 90 s.

ai_min_confidence.description: Below this the AI result is rejected as "couldn't tell", 0.1-0.9 (clamped).

posting_enabled.description: false: Post food shows "Posting is paused right now" with service_notice. Browsing, alerts, reports and blocks keep working.

service_notice.description: Banner on top of Map and Feed, max 200 characters. Empty hides it. Also shown on the posting-paused sheet.

minimum_app_version.description: Below this version the app shows Update required (no way past). e.g. 1.2. Empty = no gate. NEVER set above the live App Store version.

recommended_app_version.description: Below this version Map and Feed show a dismissible "new version" banner (once per version). Empty = none.

app_store_url.description: Update button target, must start with https://apps.apple.com/. Empty hides the button.

support_email.description: Support mailbox: Settings > Help & support, About, and [CONTACT EMAIL] in Terms and Privacy.
